newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Plants replace Hong Kong homeless before handover.
newsitem.headline: Plants replace Hong Kong homeless before handover.

text.p: Hong Kong authorities have cleared the homeless from city-centre areas ahead of the globally-televised June 30 handover to China, a newspaper said on Wednesday.
Dozens of street-sleepers who lived under a flyover have been removed, together with their chairs, canvas beds and paraffin stoves, the South China Morning Post said.
In their place are greens and a new iron fence, it said.
At midnight on June 30, Prince Charles will return Hong Kong, which Britain has ruled for 156 years, to President Jiang Zemen in an event witnessed by VIPS and journalists from all over the world.
A Social Welfare Department spokesman was quoted as denying the clearance had anything to do with the ceremony.
